Watching the Birds Around You

For anyone who could use a few calm minutes outside their own head. Each day is one small way to notice the birds near your home, work or commute, from their songs and colors to their habits through the seasons.

Mindfulness · Mindfulness · Grounding · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Glance out your nearest window for one minute and see whether a bird is anywhere in view.
  • Day 2Spot one bird on your way to wherever you are going today, and give it a few seconds of your attention.
  • Day 3Pick one bird you see often near your home and give it a name you like, even a silly one.
  • Day 4Fill a shallow dish with clean water and set it on a step, balcony or patch of ground where birds can see it.
  • Day 5Jot one word on a scrap of paper about a bird you saw today, like brave, round or noisy.
  • Day 6Wonder where the first bird you see from home today is flying off to, and watch which way it goes.
  • Day 7Sit on a park bench for five minutes and watch whatever birds come close on their own.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Look up a bird walk led by a local nature center or club and save the date.
  • Day 60Chat with a coworker about a bird you noticed on your commute this morning.
  • Day 120Close your eyes on a summer evening and listen to the birds, then write how the sounds felt.
  • Day 240Watch a nature film about birds with someone at home and talk about one moment you both liked.
  • Day 365Write a short welcome note for someone just starting to notice birds, with the one tip you would give them.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
